column1: # Live notional-vendor topic → personality .proto manifest. Consumed by
# wire_format is `json` for every row in this iteration — the synth-vendor
# binary emits JSON on the wire even though the schema body the portal
# stores is protobuf-fds. The portal's data-dictionary viewer renders the
# .fds; the inspector's "decode samples" path requires topic.format ==
# `protobuf:<MsgName>` and we leave it as `json` so the inspector doesn't
# try to protobuf-decode JSON bytes. Future PR migrates the wire format.
